title: Michelangelo Radino
content: A couple of days ago I had a dream with a strange encounter. It was one of those chaotic dreams where you only remember the last few minutes of the dream. Met a strange voice (literally nobody to see but a dark figure standing in the limelight of an abandoned hallway) who told me that there is an architect of the new world and powers from the outside will soon lead us all into this wide open and pure land. I asked who he was [the architect] and the figure/voice responded in q dark tone with a thick southwestern accent : Michelangelo Radino. He is a polymath, just like his namesake. Does this name ring a bell to anyone?
